description: The JauntyQ command-line tool: reflect a PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL/MariaDB or SQLite database into the jaunty.schema.json snapshot the source generator compiles against. Install with 'dotnet tool install --global Extrode.JauntyQ.Cli' and invoke as 'jauntyq'. Contract testing, migration impact analysis, live EXPLAIN and the schema registry are in Extrode.JauntyQ.Cli.Premium.
